title: What Teenage Mothers Really Need - A Teen Mum Psychologist’s Perspective

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚到更多钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些激动人心的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖金以及我独家提供的支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组智囊团、大师班、个性化指导、福特姆和梅森的甜点，以及限时一对一辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Teenage pregnancy is often talked about as a problem to be fixed, a mistake, a life ruin before it's even started.
sentences.zh: 人们常常把少女怀孕当作一个需要解决的问题、一个错误、一段还没开始就已经毁了的人生。

sentences.en: But those narratives rarely come from the people who've actually lived it.
sentences.zh: 但这些叙述很少来自真正亲身经历过的人。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne, a clinical psychologist, and today I'm joined by Dr. Hayley Lagasse, an educational psychologist who became a mother at the age of 15.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安博士，今天和我一起的是海莉·拉加斯博士，她是一名在15岁时成为母亲的教育心理学家。

sentences.en: We talk about what teenage mothers really need from families, professionals and systems,
sentences.zh: 我们探讨了年轻母亲真正需要来自家庭、专业人士和体制的支持是什么，

sentences.en: and how judgement, stigma and low expectations can actually do far more harm than the pregnancy itself.
sentences.zh: 以及偏见、污名和低期望值实际上如何会造成比怀孕本身更大的伤害。

sentences.en: This conversation is about support, possibility, and what happens when we actually invest in people instead of writing them off.
sentences.zh: 这场对话关乎支持、可能性，以及当我们真正投资于人而不是将他们一笔勾销时会发生什么。

sentences.en: I hope you find it so useful, and if you do, like and subscribe for more.
sentences.zh: 我希望你觉得这很有用，如果是这样，请点赞并订阅以获取更多内容。

sentences.en: Hi, I just want to welcome along to the podcast Dr. Hayley Lagasse, who is an educational psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我只想欢迎教育心理学家海莉·拉加斯博士来到播客。

sentences.en: Welcome along, Hayley.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你，海莉。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: Thanks for being here.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你能来。

sentences.en: And we are here because we want to tell a little bit about your story, but talk about how people can learn from your inspiring tale
sentences.zh: 我们在这里是因为想讲讲你的一点故事，并谈谈人们如何能从你鼓舞人心的经历中吸取经验，

sentences.en: and the experiences you've been through, both kind of adverse and kind of positive.
sentences.zh: 以及你所经历过的那些既有逆境又有积极面的体验。

sentences.en: And, you know, we're leading with the fact that you became pregnant age 14 and had your baby age 15, your first child.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们开门见山地说，你14岁怀孕，15岁生下了第一个孩子。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit about that, please, Hayley?
sentences.zh: 海莉，能给我们讲讲这方面的事吗？

sentences.en: There's lots to tell.
sentences.zh: 有好多事情可讲呢。

sentences.en: Well, so I was living in Spain at the time as a young person, having moved there at the age of 10.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当时我还是个年轻人，住在西班牙，10岁时搬到了那里。

sentences.en: I was born in Redding, England originally.
sentences.zh: 我原本出生于英格兰雷丁。

sentences.en: That was quite a big shift.
sentences.zh: 那是一个相当大的改变。

sentences.en: It was a massive transition that came with lots of challenges.
sentences.zh: 那是一次巨大的转变，伴随着许多挑战。

sentences.en: And I think part of the challenge led to me ultimately falling pregnant at quite a young age.
sentences.zh: 我想，部分挑战最终导致我在很年轻的时候就怀孕了。

sentences.en: Now, whilst I was living in Spain at the time, I believed that the age of consent for sexual relationships was 13.
sentences.zh: 当时住在西班牙时，我认为性关系的法定同意年龄是13岁。

sentences.en: And I was adamant that that was the case.
sentences.zh: 我当时非常坚信事实就是这样。

sentences.en: I'm not quite sure now, looking back, whether that was the case or not.
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，我也不太确定当时到底是不是这样。

sentences.en: However, I didn't really understand what pregnancy meant.
sentences.zh: 然而，我并不真正理解怀孕意味着什么。

sentences.en: And I didn't really understand that having relations could lead to pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 我也不太明白发生性关系会导致怀孕。

sentences.en: So it certainly wasn't a planned pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 所以这绝对不是一次有计划的怀孕。

sentences.en: And it certainly was something that was a shock when I realised, when I found out what was actually happening.
sentences.zh: 而且当我意识到、发现到底发生了什么时，这绝对是一个巨大的打击。

sentences.en: So I found myself in a relationship with a young man who was five years older than me.
sentences.zh: 当时我和一个比我大五岁的年轻男子谈恋爱。

sentences.en: So he was 19 at the time, so overage.
sentences.zh: 他当时19岁，已经成年了。

sentences.en: And we had been dating or seeing each other, getting to know each other for a couple of months before I fell pregnant.
sentences.zh: 在我怀孕前，我们已经约会或交往、相互了解了几个月。

sentences.en: And I felt quite quickly that I was in love, as you do when you're a young person.
sentences.zh: 我很快就觉得自己恋爱了，就像年轻人常有的那样。

sentences.en: So I felt pregnant, yet didn't really understand that that's what was happening.
sentences.zh: 所以我怀孕了，却并不真正明白那就是正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: That I was actually growing a child inside.
sentences.zh: 我其实是在体内孕育着一个孩子。

sentences.en: The pregnancy itself was extremely challenging, partly because of my family's response.
sentences.zh: 怀孕本身极具挑战性，部分原因是我家人的反应。

sentences.en: My mum's response in particular, who was living in Spain with me at the time.
sentences.zh: 尤其是当时和我一起住在西班牙的我妈妈的反应。

sentences.en: She found it extremely difficult to process and accept that her 14-year-old daughter was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 她觉得极难接受和消化她14岁的女儿怀孕了这件事。

sentences.en: Now, in Spain, you have the right to make decisions about your body, regardless of how old you are.
sentences.zh: 在西班牙，无论你多大年龄，你都有权对自己的身体做出决定。

sentences.en: Similar to the UK, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我想这和英国类似。

sentences.en: So I was able to decide whether or not I wanted to proceed with the pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 所以我能够决定自己是否想要继续怀孕。

sentences.en: Whereas my mum was adamant that it was best for me to have an abortion.
sentences.zh: 而我妈妈则坚决认为我最好去堕胎。

sentences.en: I declined, which was, again, really distressing for my mum,
sentences.zh: 我拒绝了，这再次让我妈妈感到非常痛苦，

sentences.en: because she truly believed that becoming a mum at such a young age was going to ruin my life and potentially ruin the child's life.
sentences.zh: 因为她坚信这么年轻就当妈妈会毁了我的人生，并可能毁了那个孩子的生命。

sentences.en: You know, the child that was going to be born.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就是即将出生的那个孩子。

sentences.en: So the early days, the early pregnancy days were particularly challenging.
sentences.zh: 所以早期，怀孕的早期阶段特别具有挑战性。

sentences.en: That led to a lot of conflict within the home.
sentences.zh: 这导致家庭内部产生了大量冲突。

sentences.en: And that did ultimately lead to me moving out.
sentences.zh: 这最终确实导致我搬了出去。

sentences.en: So no longer living with my mum, I'm moving in with my son's biological father.
sentences.zh: 所以我不再和妈妈住在一起，而是搬去跟我儿子的亲生父亲同住。

sentences.en: So the pregnancy itself was very high stress, not very well supported from my mum.
sentences.zh: 因此，怀孕本身压力非常大，没有得到妈妈太多的支持。

sentences.en: My wider family were living in England at the time or elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 我的其他家人当时住在英国或其他地方。

sentences.en: I have a brother in Canada.
sentences.zh: 我在加拿大有一个哥哥。

sentences.en: And I think that public perceptions of teenage pregnancy are quite damaging to the person that is pregnant.
sentences.zh: 我认为公众对少女怀孕的看法对怀孕的那个人是有很大伤害的。

sentences.en: And that's the case for me.
sentences.zh: 我的情况确实如此。

sentences.en: And I definitely found that even the professionals that were involved in my life were extremely judgmental at that time.
sentences.zh: 我绝对发现，甚至那些参与我生活的专业人士在当时也极其苛刻、充满偏见。

sentences.en: I have this one particular memory of going to the doctors after declining the abortion.
sentences.zh: 我有一段特别的记忆，就是在拒绝堕胎后去看医生。

sentences.en: And it was a clinical psychologist or equivalent in Spain.
sentences.zh: 那是西班牙的一位临床心理学家或同等级别的人。

sentences.en: And she shipped me off with a doll to look after for the weekend to pretend that it was a baby.
sentences.zh: 她打发我带一个洋娃娃回家过周末，假装那是一个婴儿。

sentences.en: And I just, you know, looking back now, I think it's absolutely hilarious.
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，我只觉得这简直太荒谬了。

sentences.en: Like, what good would that do?
sentences.zh: 就像，那样做有什么用？

sentences.en: Sending a doll.
sentences.zh: 送一个洋娃娃。

sentences.en: It didn't cry.
sentences.zh: 它不会哭。

sentences.en: It didn't need nappy changes.
sentences.zh: 它不需要换尿布。

sentences.en: It wasn't one of these quite advanced dolls that actually needs to be cared for.
sentences.zh: 它不是那种真正需要被照顾的高级洋娃娃。

sentences.en: It was quite literally a doll with a little cram.
sentences.zh: 它字面意思就是一个带着一小抹头发的娃娃。

sentences.en: I thought that was cute.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那挺可爱的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, the pregnancy was really challenging.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，怀孕真的充满挑战。

sentences.en: And then, of course, giving birth at the age of 15.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，就是在15岁时分娩。

sentences.en: I mean, I wouldn't wish that on anybody.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不会希望任何人经历那种事。

sentences.en: It was extremely difficult.
sentences.zh: 那极其艰难。

sentences.en: One of the midwives was extremely judgmental of me whilst I was giving birth.
sentences.zh: 其中一位助产士在我分娩时对我充满了偏见和批判。

sentences.en: Because I was crying and screaming and saying how horrible it was and how I wanted it to be over.
sentences.zh: 因为我在哭泣、尖叫，说这有多可怕，说我希望这一切快点结束。

sentences.en: And he actually made a comment to me saying that I shouldn't have opened my legs in the first place and I wouldn't be in that position.
sentences.zh: 他实际上对我说了一句评论，说我当初不该随便张开双腿，也就不会落得现在这个地步。

sentences.en: And I think some people don't believe me when I say that.
sentences.zh: 我想有些人听到我说这话时根本不相信。

sentences.en: It genuinely, genuinely happened.
sentences.zh: 这千真万确，确确实实发生过。

sentences.en: And it shocks me that there were people out there that could treat somebody who's going through one of the most difficult things they probably ever will in their lives and to say such a thing.
sentences.zh: 让我震惊的是，竟然有人会对一个正在经历人生中最艰难时刻之一的人说出这样的话。

sentences.en: So, hopefully, that gives you a snapshot of what that experience was like.
sentences.zh: 所以，希望这能让你对那段经历有一个大致的了解。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, I'm so sorry to hear that that was your experience.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，听到那是你的经历，我感到非常遗憾。

sentences.en: And, you know, a woman who's in her 30s or her 40s often says, I want this to be over.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，三十多岁或四十多岁的女性也经常会说：“我希望这一切快点结束。”

sentences.en: You know, I don't want to do this anymore.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，“我不想再这样下去了。”

sentences.en: And that's because it really hurts, you know.
sentences.zh: 那是因为真的很痛，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I was really struck with empathy for you as a teenage mum.
sentences.zh: 作为一名年轻妈妈，我对你充满了深深的同感。

sentences.en: It was making me think about my experiences of my first pregnancy with my son who's now 12.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了我怀现在12岁的大儿子时的经历。

sentences.en: And it was a planned pregnancy, but I went along to the midwife clinic.
sentences.zh: 那是一次有计划的怀孕，但我去妇产诊所时

sentences.en: I was very excited and, you know, all of that and, you know, any appointments I had with my GP.
sentences.zh: 非常兴奋，你知道的，诸如此类，还有我去全科医生那里的任何预约。

sentences.en: And I would have been so very upset and so very distressed if someone had suggested abortion with me because this is a baby that already feels like part of me.
sentences.zh: 如果有人向我建议堕胎，我会非常难过和痛苦，因为这是一个已经让我觉得是身体一部分的宝宝。

sentences.en: And I've already, you know, looked at what size blueberry they are in the apps.
sentences.zh: 而且我已经，你知道的，在应用程序上查看过他们长得像多大的蓝莓了。

sentences.en: And I already felt like a mother and we can't assume that because a mother, a mother to be is young, that she's not also having those same psychological changes.
sentences.zh: 我当时就已经觉得自己是个母亲了，我们不能仅仅因为一位准妈妈年轻，就认为她没有经历那些相同的心理变化。

sentences.en: And really, really hard, Hayley.
sentences.zh: 海莉，这真的、真的很不容易。

sentences.en: I'm so sorry that you experienced that.
sentences.zh: 很遗憾你经历了那些。

sentences.en: Hence, I'm here raising awareness because I suppose part of my life goal is trying to change people's perceptions of people in general.
sentences.zh: 因此，我在这里提高公众意识，因为我想我的人生目标之一就是试图改变人们对大众的看法。

sentences.en: But teenage parents is obviously people that matter a lot to me and trying to change the narrative about the outcomes for the children,
sentences.zh: 但年轻父母显然是对我很重要的人，我试图改变关于孩子们未来的这种叙事，

sentences.en: because I think there's so much focus on the negative sides and the downsides of being such a young parent.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为人们太过于关注作为如此年轻的父母的消极面和缺点了。

sentences.en: And absolutely, it's extremely challenging and outcomes can not be so good.
sentences.zh: 当然，这极具挑战性，结果可能确实不那么好。

sentences.en: But then that could be the same for a parent at any age.
sentences.zh: 但任何年龄的父母也同样可能面临这种情况。

sentences.en: You know, it doesn't matter just because you're in your 30s.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这没有关系，并不是说你三十多岁

sentences.en: It doesn't mean that you're going to have the best possible life or be able to give your child exactly what they need for the rest of their life.
sentences.zh: 就意味着你一定会过上最好的生活，或者能够满足孩子余生所需的全部需求。

sentences.en: So I think that that narrative really needs shifting.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这种陈旧的叙事确实需要改变。

sentences.en: Hence, hence I talk about my experience so much.
sentences.zh: 因此，因此我才如此频繁地讲述我的经历。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we're probably going to focus more in on teenage mothers here today.
sentences.zh: 今天我们可能把重点更多地放在年轻母亲身上。

sentences.en: But of course, we might might cover teenage fathers as well.
sentences.zh: 但当然，我们可能也会涉及年轻父亲。

sentences.en: And if people are interested in learning more about teenage fathers,
sentences.zh: 如果人们有兴趣了解更多关于年轻父亲的信息，

sentences.en: there's a really great episode that I did previously on a project that's operating to support teen fathers to optimally thrive as as parents, really,
sentences.zh: 我以前做过一期非常棒的节目，关于一个旨在支持年轻父亲作为父母真正实现最佳成长的项目，

sentences.en: not just as as something that's shame filled and, you know, should be covered up.
sentences.zh: 而不是仅仅把这当成一件充满羞耻、你知道的、应该被掩盖的事情。

sentences.en: So, yeah, please do check that out in the description or the show notes.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，请务必查看简介或节目备注中的相关内容。

sentences.en: But, you know, if we could have, you know, I guess people might be watching this for a variety of reasons.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，如果我们能……我想人们观看这个节目可能有各种各样的原因。

sentences.en: They might be a parent themselves who's now got a teenage daughter, maybe who's pregnant or someone that they care about who's pregnant and they're seeking to understand.
sentences.zh: 他们自己可能就是父母，现在有了一个十几岁的女儿，也许女儿怀孕了，或者他们有亲近的人怀孕了，他们正在寻求理解。

sentences.en: Or they might be working in mental health and kind of wondering how to support people or how to speak about them respectfully.
sentences.zh: 或者他们可能从事心理健康工作，在想如何支持这些人，或者如何尊重地谈论他们。

sentences.en: What what would be useful for us to share at this point, I guess, Hayley, for whoever's watching?
sentences.zh: 海莉，对于无论谁在观看这个节目，我们在此分享什么会比较有用呢？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: That's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: Really good question.
sentences.zh: 真的是个好问题。

sentences.en: I think for me, the most important thing would be that whilst finding out that your daughter at a very young age is pregnant can be extremely distressing for you.
sentences.zh: 对我和我而言，最重要的事情是，尽管发现自己很年轻的女儿怀孕会让你感到极其痛苦，

sentences.en: I think it's extremely important to acknowledge those feelings and sit with them as much as you need to.
sentences.zh: 但我认为极其重要的是承认这些感受，并花尽可能多的时间去接受它们。

sentences.en: But to not forget that your daughter is most likely also finding this extremely challenging, whether it was a planned pregnancy or not.
sentences.zh: 但不要忘记，无论是否是计划中的怀孕，你的女儿很可能也觉得这极其具有挑战性。

sentences.en: In my instance, it was not a planned pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 在我的例子中，这不是一次有计划的怀孕。

sentences.en: So I had the shock of finding out that I was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时面临着发现自己怀孕的震惊。

sentences.en: Whereas I know that there are some young ladies out there that do plan on having babies at a very young age.
sentences.zh: 而我知道有些年轻女性确实计划在很年轻的时候生孩子。

sentences.en: But regardless, it's a very difficult thing for them to go through.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，这对她们来说都是一件非常难熬的事情。

sentences.en: And when you're pregnant, you know, those of us that have had children, we know how challenging it is.
sentences.zh: 当你怀孕的时候，你知道的，我们这些生过孩子的人都知道有多难。

sentences.en: All our hormones are going crazy.
sentences.zh: 我们所有的荷尔蒙都在疯狂飙升。

sentences.en: We're feeling emotional.
sentences.zh: 我们情绪化。

sentences.en: We might be experiencing morning sickness and all these other symptoms, I guess, of pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会经历晨吐以及所有其他怀孕的症状，我想是的。

sentences.en: And the most useful thing for me in that moment would have been to have had a supportive parent, a parent that put her own feelings aside.
sentences.zh: 对当时的我来说，最有用的是能有一个支持我的父母，一个能把自己的感受放在一边的父母。

sentences.en: For me, it was just my mum.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那就是我妈妈。

sentences.en: If she could have put her own feelings aside, had her moments, cried, screamed, you know, have done whatever she needed to do with her support network.
sentences.zh: 如果她能把自己的情绪先放一放，去经历她的时刻、哭泣、尖叫，你知道的，跟她的支持网络去做她需要做的事，

sentences.en: And then to have supported me and understood, this is the way that it's going to be.
sentences.zh: 然后来支持我、理解我：事情就是这样了。

sentences.en: It's not going to be easy, but I'm going to be with you.
sentences.zh: 这不会容易，但我会陪着你。

sentences.en: You know, I'm going to walk alongside you.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我会陪在你身边。

sentences.en: I'm going to guide you.
sentences.zh: 我会指导你。

sentences.en: I'm going to mentor you the best that I can.
sentences.zh: 我会尽我所能当你的导师。

sentences.en: And we will get through this together.
sentences.zh: 我们会一起度过难关的。

sentences.en: I think that that's that's likely to support better outcomes for both the mum and the child rather than pushing your daughter away.
sentences.zh: 我认为这更有可能为母亲和孩子带来更好的结果，而不是把女儿推开。

sentences.en: And that's, I think, where I get most distress is when I see mums or parents pushing their daughter away because they've fallen pregnant,
sentences.zh: 我想，当我看到母亲或父母因为女儿怀孕而把她们推开时，我感到最痛心，

sentences.en: because actually they're less likely to receive the right support and therefore the outcomes could could not be so great.
sentences.zh: 因为事实上她们更难获得正确的支持，因此结果可能就不会那么好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think I was thinking about the term of what we talk about in psychology is containment.
sentences.zh: 我想我刚刚在想的是，我们在心理学中讨论的一个概念，叫做“容纳”。

sentences.en: So, yeah, like you might not be thrilled about it and you might even share some of that with your daughter and kind of be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，也许你对这事并不是那么兴奋，甚至可能把这些感受和女儿分享了一点，表现得很诚实。

sentences.en: This is a real shock, but it's not hopefully done from a position of of crossness and that, you know, there's not massive amounts of distress after the initial news.
sentences.zh: 这确实是个不小的打击，但希望这并不是出于愤怒，而且你知道的，在最初的消息过后，并没有产生巨大的痛苦。

sentences.en: You know, it's going to take a while to adjust initially, I guess.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，一开始需要一段时间来适应，我想。

sentences.en: But but really, if you're not managing that, it shouldn't just be your daughter that that's getting that and seeing that, you know, like you said,
sentences.zh: 但真的，如果你自己都应付不来，那不应该只有你的女儿去承受和看到这些，就像你说的，

sentences.en: it might be that you've got your own parents around your friends.
sentences.zh: 也许你身边有自己的父母和朋友。

sentences.en: You know, maybe your siblings, you know, maybe reaching out for, you know, discussions with someone that's qualified to support you to explore this,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，也许还有兄弟姐妹，也许可以去寻求与具备专业资质的人进行探讨，支持你来探索这一点，

sentences.en: maybe even any local organisations who do support teenage mothers or people that have got kind of families that don't look typical.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能包括任何支持年轻母亲或家庭状况不太典型的当地组织。

sentences.en: Yeah, like it shouldn't just be the daughter's responsibility to soak all that up.
sentences.zh: 是的，这不应该仅仅是女儿一个人的责任去全部承担。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, the daughter is going to have a lot on their mind.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，女儿心里也会装满很多事情。

sentences.en: So I think as much as the parents can do to support, it would go down really well.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，只要父母能尽力去支持，效果一定会非常好。

sentences.en: I think also important to mention is that we tend to fixate on the what could go wrong and the negatives.
sentences.zh: 我认为同样值得一提的是，我们往往会死盯着可能会出问题的地方和消极面。

sentences.en: And we tend to, I think, catastrophize the future outcomes for both the mother and the child.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，我们往往会把母亲和孩子未来的结局过度灾难化。

sentences.en: Whereas actually there are so many stories of young parents, young mums that have gone on to do extremely well.
sentences.zh: 然而实际上，有那么多年轻父母、年轻妈妈后来都过得极其出色的故事。

sentences.en: They've been great parents.
sentences.zh: 他们成为了伟大的父母。

sentences.en: They've raised, you know, successful, healthy, happy children that have gone on into adulthood and done very well.
sentences.zh: 他们抚养出了，你知道的，成功、健康、快乐的孩子，这些孩子长大成人，并且发展得很好。

sentences.en: So I think it's really important to try not to think in the most negative way and try to reframe the way that you're thinking.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，尽量不要往最坏的方面去想，并试着重新构架你的思维方式，这真的非常重要。

sentences.en: If you're automatically going to, oh, my goodness, you're ruining your life.
sentences.zh: 如果你下意识地觉得，天哪，你这是在毁了自己的一生。

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不是这样的。

sentences.en: Is it going to be a little bit challenging initially?
sentences.zh: 一开始会有点挑战吗？

sentences.en: Most likely.
sentences.zh: 很有可能。

sentences.en: Are you going to potentially have to put on pause some of your dreams and hopes?
sentences.zh: 你可能不得不暂时搁置一些梦想和希望吗？

sentences.en: Probably, yes, just like I have to.
sentences.zh: 可能会的，是的，就像我当年一样。

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean that you then can't come back to those a little bit later in life when you're ready to.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着等你准备好了之后，在人生稍后的阶段就不能重新去追求这些了。

sentences.en: And alongside that, you're going to have the joy of being a parent.
sentences.zh: 并且与此同时，你还将拥有为人父母的快乐。

sentences.en: So for me, it's been a really beautiful experience.
sentences.zh: 所以对我和说，这是一段非常美好的经历。

sentences.en: Extremely challenging.
sentences.zh: 极其具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Would I have done it differently if I would have known better?
sentences.zh: 如果早知如此，我会做出不同的选择吗？

sentences.en: Potentially.
sentences.zh: 也许会吧。

sentences.en: But those weren't the circumstances I found myself in.
sentences.zh: 但那并不是我当时所处的环境。

sentences.en: So, yeah, try to change the narrative, I guess, for yourself about the future.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，试着为自己改变一下关于未来的叙事方式吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, let's focus on the positives.
sentences.zh: 是的，让我们把重点放在积极的方面。

sentences.en: You know, hopefully you've enjoyed being a parent and now you've got your daughter who is now pregnant.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，希望你曾经享受过为人父母的快乐，而现在你的女儿也怀孕了。

sentences.en: But, yeah, it's not it doesn't always need to be from a position of lack, does it?
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，这并不总是意味着事情就是一种缺失，对吧？

sentences.en: And actually, you know, having worked with a lot of families where babies have turned up unexpectedly.
sentences.zh: 而且事实上，你知道的，在和许多意外迎来宝宝的家庭共事过之后，

sentences.en: That child has really been a great joy to the families, to the extended families.
sentences.zh: 那个孩子确实给整个家庭、给大家庭带来了巨大的欢乐。

sentences.en: You know, grandparents got to become grandparents sooner than expected.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，祖父母比预期更早地当上了爷爷奶奶和外公外婆。

sentences.en: And, you know, been around in better health to be able to enjoy them as well.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，还能以更健康的身体去享受这一切。

sentences.en: Like it's not all it's not all negative.
sentences.zh: 这并不是全部，并不是全都是消极的。

sentences.en: Obviously, children are not free.
sentences.zh: 很显然，养孩子可不是免费的。

sentences.en: Mine are really expensive.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们开销可真大。

sentences.en: So that that is tricky.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实挺棘手的。

sentences.en: And I think certainly having grown up in England, a lot of the narrative around teenage pregnancies was kind of, you know, living on benefits, getting a council house.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，在英国长大的经历必然让我觉得，许多关于未成年怀孕的论调都是那种，你知道的，靠领救济金生活，分到一套廉租房。

sentences.en: It was never thought of as a as a positive thing.
sentences.zh: 人们从来不把它当成一件积极的事来看待。

sentences.en: And I think there was lots of shame, lots of blame, lots of stigma.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这里面包含了很多羞耻感、很多指责、很多污名化。

sentences.en: How was that for you in Spain?
sentences.zh: 在西班牙，你的情况是怎样的呢？

sentences.en: Great question.
sentences.zh: 好问题。

sentences.en: So Spain, again, we are talking 17 years ago when this happened.
sentences.zh: 所以西班牙那边，我们说的是17年前发生的事。

sentences.en: So things may have shifted in Spain.
sentences.zh: 所以现在西班牙的情况可能已经有所改变了。

sentences.en: The benefit system is very, very different.
sentences.zh: 那里的福利制度非常非常不同。

sentences.en: So when I found myself pregnant, we were already struggling financially significantly.
sentences.zh: 所以当我发现自己怀孕时，我们的经济状况已经陷入了极大的困境。

sentences.en: I would describe ourselves as living in quite extreme poverty at the time.
sentences.zh: 我可以说当时我们过着相当极端贫困的生活。

sentences.en: So, of course, falling pregnant definitely brought added stress because of the coSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，怀孕自然而然地因为开销问题带来了额外的压力。

sentences.en: There is no benefit system whereby you can get, for example, housing benefits, support you to find a place to live.
sentences.zh: 那里并没有那种你可以获得例如住房补贴、支持你找地方住的福利制度。

sentences.en: And even things like support to eat on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 甚至连每天吃饭的支持这样的事情都没有。

sentences.en: There wasn't a benefit for that, for example, like a living benefit.
sentences.zh: 比如说，根本没有类似生活津贴这样的福利。

sentences.en: So we had to very much rely on the churches that would give out boxes of food as well as food banks that were in the local area.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不得不非常依赖教会发放的食物盒，以及当地的食物银行。

sentences.en: And often those didn't come with the right foods that we needed, even things like formula, for example.
sentences.zh: 而且通常这些救济里面并没有我们真正需要的合适食物，甚至连婴儿配方奶粉都没有。

sentences.en: I was able to breastfeed for the first four months.
sentences.zh: 我前四个月还能进行母乳喂养。

sentences.en: But then we moved on to formula and we could not afford formula.
sentences.zh: 但后来我们就得转喝配方奶了，而我们根本买不起配方奶。

sentences.en: So we very much had to rely on the generosity of the churches, the food banks, and often go hungry myself to make sure that the little one was fed.
sentences.zh: 所以我们极大地依赖教会和食物银行的慷慨解囊，而且经常是我自己挨饿，来确保小家伙能吃饱。

sentences.en: So that was a significant challenge.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: And that, I guess, is something that people do need to be very mindful of.
sentences.zh: 我想，这也是人们确实需要深思的一点。

sentences.en: It did get to a point, unfortunately, in my situation where I did find myself having to steal and find ways of making money that I wouldn't do now.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，在我的情况下，甚至一度发展到我不得不去偷窃，去寻找那些我现在绝不会去做的赚钱方式。

sentences.en: Because you do what you have to do when you're a parent.
sentences.zh: 因为当你成为父母时，你必须做你不得不做的事。

sentences.en: You have so much love for your child that you will do anything to make sure they're fed.
sentences.zh: 你对孩子的爱是如此深沉，以至于你愿意付出一切来确保他们吃饱。

sentences.en: So, yeah, very, very different to here.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这与这里的情况非常非常不同。

sentences.en: I returned to England when my son was two and I was extremely grateful to be able to come back and receive the benefit support that I desperately needed to help me progress with my life.
sentences.zh: 在我儿子两岁时我回到了英国，我极其感激能够回来并获得我迫切需要的福利支持，这帮助我推进了生活。

sentences.en: Even something like, for example, being able to return to education.
sentences.zh: 甚至像重返校园接受教育这样的事情。

sentences.en: I left school with no GCSEs, so I had no prospects.
sentences.zh: 我离开学校时连一个GCSE（中学毕业文凭）都没有，所以我没有任何前途。

sentences.en: I had no future at that time.
sentences.zh: 那时我根本没有未来可言。

sentences.en: I potentially would have even struggled to get a job in a shop, for example, because of my social skills at that time.
sentences.zh: 由于当时的社交能力，我甚至可能连去商店找份工作都会很艰难。

sentences.en: But the government system, the benefit system, enabled me to go back to college to start getting my qualifications.
sentences.zh: 但是政府体制、福利制度让我能够重返大学去获取资格证书。

sentences.en: And they funded a nursery place for my little boy.
sentences.zh: 他们为我的小男孩资助了一个托儿所的名额。

sentences.en: And I didn't have to pay a penny.
sentences.zh: 我一分钱都不用付。

sentences.en: And on top of that, they contributed to paying for my flat that I lived in through housing benefit.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他们通过住房津贴帮我支付了我所居住的公寓的房租。

sentences.en: So looking at where I am today now, working as an educational psychologist,
sentences.zh: 所以看看我今天的现状，作为一名教育心理学家，

sentences.en: I actually have a lot of gratitude to the UK benefit system for enabling me to make steps towards my future.
sentences.zh: 我其实对英国的福利制度充满了感激，是它让我能够朝着未来迈出步伐。

sentences.en: And I think it's thinking about not just the person you are now as a 14-year-old mother.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这不仅仅是关于你作为一个14岁母亲的现在的样子。

sentences.en: And ultimately, when you came to the UK, a 16-year-old mother, we're investing in the future, Dr. Hayley Lagasse, right?
sentences.zh: 归根结底，当你来到英国时，你是一个16岁的母亲，我们在投资未来，海莉·拉加斯博士，对吧？

sentences.en: Because actually now you are fully kind of, you know, paying tax and part of society.
sentences.zh: 因为实际上现在你已经完全在，你知道的，纳税并成为社会的一部分了。

sentences.en: And, you know, you're a consumer.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你也是个消费者。

sentences.en: And that cannot be underestimated.
sentences.zh: 这是绝对不能被低估的。

sentences.en: If we support people well, they give back into the system.
sentences.zh: 如果我们好好支持人们，他们就会回馈这个系统。

sentences.en: And, you know, with your work supporting children, young people, schools and families, you are giving back in abundance.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，凭借你支持儿童、年轻人、学校和家庭的工作，你正在做出丰厚的回报。

sentences.en: So let's not forget about that, too.
sentences.zh: 所以我们也不要忘记这一点。

sentences.en: I absolutely agree.
sentences.zh: 我完全赞同。

sentences.en: I'm so glad that you said that.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能这么说。

sentences.en: But, yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，绝对如此。

sentences.en: Let's invest in people.
sentences.zh: 让我们投资于人吧。

sentences.en: And as I said, I have so much gratitude.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我满怀感激。

sentences.en: And I feel a real responsibility to give back and to talk about the positives that this country has given me.
sentences.zh: 我感到有一种切实的责任去回馈，去谈论这个国家给予我的种种积极面。

sentences.en: Because I wouldn't be where I am today.
sentences.zh: 因为如果没有这些，我就不会有今天的成就。

sentences.en: And I am in such a great place today.
sentences.zh: 而我今天正处于如此美妙的状态中。

sentences.en: And that's, you know, thanks to all of the support that was offered, not just financially, but emotionally, all of the support services that were available,
sentences.zh: 这都要归功于当时提供的所有支持，不仅仅是经济上的，还有情感上的，以及所有可用的支持服务，

sentences.en: like short start centres back when they were quite common.
sentences.zh: 比如当年非常普遍的“Sure Start”儿童中心。

sentences.en: And I'm so extremely thankful to everybody that now I want to be contributing and giving back.
sentences.zh: 我由衷地感谢每一个人，以至于现在我也想贡献力量、回馈社会。

sentences.en: And I really hope that, yeah, that people can see that and start to change the way they're seeing things.
sentences.zh: 我真的希望，是的，人们能看到这一点，并开始改变他们的看法。

sentences.en: Invest in people and they do give back.
sentences.zh: 投资于人，他们自然会给予回报。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm going to ask you a question now.
sentences.zh: 我现在要问你一个问题。

sentences.en: It might be that we need to pause the recording whilst we have a think about it.
sentences.zh: 我们可能需要在思考这个问题时暂停一下录音。

sentences.en: Or you might be like, no, I know the answer already.
sentences.zh: 或者你可能会说，不，我早就知道答案了。

sentences.en: But if we were to kind of think about UK landscape now, we've got a 14-year-old teenage mother who's decided she wants to keep her baby.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们来想想英国现在的环境，我们有一位14岁的年轻母亲，她决定要留下自己的宝宝。

sentences.en: What could we put in place or what would be an ideal gold standard experience for her, for her and her baby, who she's growing still currently, to thrive?
sentences.zh: 我们可以为她建立什么机制，或者对她和她腹中依然在孕育的宝宝来说，怎样才算是一个理想的、最高标准的体验，能让她们茁壮成长？

sentences.en: And if we need to pause for a moment, that's absolutely OK.
sentences.zh: 如果我们需要暂停一会儿，那完全没问题。

sentences.en: But I really would like to think about what a gold standard would look like.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很想探讨一下什么才算是最高标准。

sentences.en: That's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: I'm going to do that thing where I say that I think it would be context dependent.
sentences.zh: 我要用那种老套的说法来回答，我觉得这取决于具体的情境。

sentences.en: And I think it will very much depend on the mother and what their circumstances are.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这很大程度上要取决于这位母亲以及她所处的环境。

sentences.en: I think it would be very different for a 14-year-old young lady who's fallen pregnant and has got a really large, very supportive family,
sentences.zh: 我认为对于一个怀孕了、并且拥有一个非常庞大且极其支持她的家庭的14岁年轻女孩来说，情况会大不相同，

sentences.en: perhaps two parents who are going to be the grandparents that would be able to help look after the baby so that she could continue with education.
sentences.zh: 也许她的父母将成为外祖父母，能够帮忙照顾宝宝，这样她就能继续学业。

sentences.en: So I think that perhaps the support that she needs is going to be very different to somebody like me, who's only maybe got one parent or no contact really with their families,
sentences.zh: 所以我想，她需要的支持可能和像我这样的人非常不同，我可能只有一个父母，或者与家人几乎没有联系，

sentences.en: living in poverty.
sentences.zh: 生活在贫困之中。

sentences.en: Maybe they've got additional needs and really struggle educationally.
sentences.zh: 也许她们有额外的需求，在学业上面临很大困难。

sentences.en: So I don't think that there is one gold standard that would be, you know, it's not one size fits all.
sentences.zh: 所以我不认为存在一个放之四海皆准的最高标准，你知道的，这不是一刀切的。

sentences.en: I think that for me personally, it's all down to ensuring that that young mum continues to have access to education, has access to a support network, whatever that is,
sentences.zh: 我认为对我自己个人而言，关键在于确保这位年轻妈妈能够继续接受教育，能够获得支持网络，无论那是什么形式，

sentences.en: whether that's family or whether that is professional or professional supporting them to develop their own non-professional support network.
sentences.zh: 无论是家庭还是专业人士，亦或是专业人士支持她们去建立自己的非专业支持网络。

sentences.en: And supporting them to, you know, think about the future, learn about things that they may not know about in terms of being a parent, support them with life skills,
sentences.zh: 并支持她们，你知道的，去思考未来，去学习那些作为父母她们可能还不太了解的事物，支持她们掌握生活技能、

sentences.en: practical skills, managing money, things that we don't really think about that are really important when you become a parent.
sentences.zh: 实用技能、理财能力——这些我们在成为父母前不怎么会去考虑、但又至关重要的事情。

sentences.en: So bring it kind of to put that into their package, I suppose, which I don't think the education system currently does very well.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，把这些融入她们的帮扶套餐中，而我认为教育系统目前在这方面做得并不算好。

sentences.en: But yes, as I've said, I think it will be really context dependent.
sentences.zh: 但是是的，正如我所说，我认为这非常取决于具体的情境。

sentences.en: Yeah, thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 是的，谢谢你的回答。

sentences.en: And I did throw that as a bit of a curveball, but I think I would also want her to have a dedicated, safe, non-judgmental mentor, really,
sentences.zh: 我刚才抛出了一个有点难对付的问题，但我认为我还希望她能有一位专职的、安全的、不带评判色彩的导师，真的，

sentences.en: to see her through from wherever she is now to the first two or three years, maybe even the first five years of her baby's life.
sentences.zh: 陪伴她从目前的处境一直走到宝宝出生后的前两三年，甚至前五年。

sentences.en: And that might be a mummy.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一位妈妈。

sentences.en: It might be another female.
sentences.zh: 可能是另一位女性。

sentences.en: It might be a man, I don't know, but someone that has got a really good heart that is going to give her that space to thrive,
sentences.zh: 也可能是个男性，我不知道，但必须是一个真正心地善良、能给她提供成长空间的贵人，

sentences.en: but also share some of her vulnerabilities and kind of be there toe for toe.
sentences.zh: 同时也能分担她的一些脆弱，在困境中与她并肩作战。

sentences.en: And maybe sometimes they happen in, you know, I remember when I had a health visitor coming and kind of, you know, watching me with my child.
sentences.zh: 有时也许会有些干预，你知道的，我记得我当访视员来访时，会观察我和孩子的互动。

sentences.en: And maybe there's some element of that as well, but actually some element of just let's go for a cup of tea and see how you are and what's feeling hard right now.
sentences.zh: 也许其中也包含某种程度的监督，但实际上，更多的只是一种“我们去喝杯茶吧，看看你最近怎么样，有什么觉得艰难的地方”这样的陪伴。

sentences.en: And, you know, that would be a really lovely addition.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那会是一个非常美好的补充。

sentences.en: I think that would be absolutely wonderful.
sentences.zh: 我认为那绝对会棒极了。

sentences.en: And that's, I suppose, what I kind of felt from the staff at the Shore Start Centre when I did return.
sentences.zh: 我想，当我重返“Sure Start”儿童中心时，从那里的工作人员身上感受到的差不多就是这种氛围。

sentences.en: It was, although they weren't dedicated to me, because of the amount of times that I spent there, I developed really lovely relationships with the staff.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们不是专门为我一个人服务的，但由于我呆在那里的时间很多，我和工作人员建立非常美好的关系。

sentences.en: And it was, you know, the same staff there consistently.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，那里的工作人员一直都是同一批人。

sentences.en: And I could just pop in and have the non-judgmental conversations.
sentences.zh: 我可以随时过去进行不带评判的交流。

sentences.en: I could go and say, God, this is absolutely exhausting.
sentences.zh: 我可以跑过去说，天哪，这简直太累人了。

sentences.en: I don't think I can continue doing this.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我快撑不下去了。

sentences.en: But they also had the knowledge and skill to be able to help me and tell me and explain how to do things differently.
sentences.zh: 但他们同时也具备知识和技能，能够帮助我、告诉我并解释如何用不同的方式去处理。

sentences.en: And I really respected them for that.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常尊敬他们。

sentences.en: I didn't feel like they were there judging me.
sentences.zh: 我并不觉得他们是在那里评判我。

sentences.en: I didn't feel like they were coming to check on my baby's weight or is, are they, you know, is your little weight eating enough?
sentences.zh: 我并不觉得他们是来检查我宝宝的体重，或者说，他们是不是在想，你的小家伙有没有吃饱？

sentences.en: So I think that's potentially a challenge with health visitors is that, you know, from my second child, who's now seven, definitely felt that when they came around,
sentences.zh: 所以我想这可能是保健访视员潜在的一个挑战，你知道的，对于我的第二个孩子，他现在七岁了，当他们来访时确实有这种感觉，

sentences.en: although they were lovely, there was an element of checking, you know, checking the house, checking the weight.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们很可爱，但其中确实带有一点检查的成分，你知道的，检查房子，检查体重。

sentences.en: Is everything being done as it should?
sentences.zh: 一切都按要求做了吗？

sentences.en: We know that safeguarding was on their mind.
sentences.zh: 我们知道安全保障一直是他们心头的大事。

sentences.en: If we could slightly remove that, then I feel that the relationships could be a lot better for the mum and baby.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能稍微消除这一点，我觉得妈妈和宝宝之间的关系会融洽得多。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And also you need, you know, it was really hard.
sentences.zh: 而且你也需要，你知道的，那真的很难。

sentences.en: My eldest woke up like 31 times a night when he was at his worSt.
sentences.zh: 我大儿子情况最糟糕的时候，一晚上能醒来31次左右。

sentences.en: Really hard.
sentences.zh: 真的很难。

sentences.en: You know, I was just bone cold.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我当时简直透心凉。

sentences.en: Like my bones felt cold because I was so tired and I was more emotional because I was just so exhausted.
sentences.zh: 就像骨头里都觉得冷，因为我太累了，而且因为极度筋疲力尽，情绪也更加崩溃。

sentences.en: And so if I went to a mum and baby group and I had a particularly hard night, I might well be in tears.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我去参加妈妈和婴儿聚会，而前一晚又特别难熬，我可能就会当场哭出来。

sentences.en: It's really hard.
sentences.zh: 真的很难。

sentences.en: It's really hard.
sentences.zh: 真的很难。

sentences.en: But at no point did anyone ever say, do you want to give your child up for adoption?
sentences.zh: 但从来没有任何人在任何时候问过：你想把孩子送去寄养吗？

sentences.en: But, you know, I think a young mum experiencing some of the same things is more likely to have that question asked to her.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我觉得经历同样情况的年轻妈妈，更容易被问到这个问题。

sentences.en: But that's not what she's saying necessarily.
sentences.zh: 但她不一定就是这个意思。

sentences.en: She might be saying that.
sentences.zh: 她可能是在这么说。

sentences.en: Maybe you can support her to explore options.
sentences.zh: 也许你可以支持她去探索各种选择。

sentences.en: But also she's just looking for validation.
sentences.zh: 但同时她也只是在寻求认可。

sentences.en: This is the hardest thing I've ever done.
sentences.zh: 这是我做过最难的事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I don't think it should matter how old you are.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得你的年龄有多大并不重要。

sentences.en: I think, as you said, regardless of how old you are when you have your first child, second child, third child, it's exhausting.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，正如你所说，不管你生第一个孩子、第二个孩子还是第三个孩子时多大年纪，这都是精疲力竭的。

sentences.en: And each baby is different.
sentences.zh: 而且每个宝宝都不一样。

sentences.en: You know, I waited for nine years until I had my second child because it was so hard due to circumstances.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我等了九年才生第二个孩子，因为由于种种情况，过程太艰难了。

sentences.en: And I thought that it would be an absolute breeze.
sentences.zh: 我本以为这会是一件轻而易举的事。

sentences.en: And no, it's been equally as difficult for different reasons.
sentences.zh: 然而并没有，出于不同的原因，同样非常艰难。

sentences.en: So, yeah, just having somebody there that can just listen to you, make you a cup of tea, offer to hold the baby, come and do a bit of washing up for you.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，只要有个人能在那里听你倾诉，给你泡杯茶，主动提出抱抱孩子，过来帮你洗个碗。

sentences.en: You know, just those nice practical supports would be so, so beneficial to all mums, but particularly young muMs.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所有这些贴心的实际支持对所有妈妈都大有裨益，尤其是年轻妈妈。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I wish I'd had someone to come around and hold my baby because I've got another friend also called Marianne.
sentences.zh: 我真希望当时有人能过来帮我抱抱孩子，因为我还有另一个朋友也叫玛丽安。

sentences.en: I don't think she'll mind me calling her out on this.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她不会介意我当众点名。

sentences.en: But we, when our children, our first babies were little, we'd go swimming together.
sentences.zh: 但我们、当我们的孩子、第一个宝宝还小的时候，我们会一起去游泳。

sentences.en: And genuinely, we'd take all of our shower gels.
sentences.zh: 说真的，我们会带上所有的沐浴露。

sentences.en: We'd take our shampoo and our conditioner and our body puff and our razors.
sentences.zh: 我们会带上洗发水、护发素、沐浴球和剃须刀。

sentences.en: And we would poolside have our only shower that week.
sentences.zh: 我们会在泳池边洗我们在那一周里唯一的一次澡。

sentences.en: And we called it our spa.
sentences.zh: 我们把它叫做我们的水疗中心。

sentences.en: But our kids would be sat on the floor and would be fully showering and together, side by side, like with people swimming up and down.
sentences.zh: 但我们的孩子会坐在地板上，我们就这样并排着彻底洗澡，旁边有人在游来游去。

sentences.en: But we cannot have been the only mums in the country to be doing that.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不可能是全国唯一这样做的妈妈。

sentences.en: But, you know, what I've learned is showers and being clean and having clean hair helped me feel more put together and helped me manage everything.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我学到的是，洗澡、保持干净以及拥有一头干净的头发能让我感觉状态更好，并帮我应付一切。

sentences.en: So I wish someone had supported me to bathe more often, which sounds ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望当初有人能支持我更频繁地洗澡，听起来可能很荒谬。

sentences.en: But actually, that would have helped my bones to warm up and for me to feel like I didn't look such a state.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，那会帮我的骨头暖和起来，让我觉得自己看起来不那么狼狈。

sentences.en: I remember I was in a supermarket and I'd seen a leaflet a few days ago about life insurance.
sentences.zh: 我记得我曾在一家超市里，几天前刚看到过一张关于人寿保险的传单。

sentences.en: And I think at the time I was 32, maybe 33, and they said, oh, do you mean our over 50 plan?
sentences.zh: 我想当时我32岁，也许33岁，他们说，哦，你是说我们针对50岁以上人群的计划吗？

sentences.en: And I was like, no, like, how not put together I was looking in my jumble sale outfit, whatever it was.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，不，我是说我穿着旧货摊买来的衣服，无论那是什么，看起来是多么的不修边幅。

sentences.en: But just let's support mothers to have a chance of optimally thriving.
sentences.zh: 但让我们去支持母亲们，让她们有机会达到最佳的繁荣状态。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，对，绝对的。

sentences.en: Make them food.
sentences.zh: 给她们做饭。

sentences.en: I think that's one of my really, really practical ones, especially when you're a teenage mum and potentially haven't yet learned how to cook, which was definitely the case for me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是我非常、非常实用的建议之一，特别是当你是一个十几岁的妈妈，可能还没学会做饭时，我当年绝对就是这样。

sentences.en: I knew how to wash clothes to a certain extent.
sentences.zh: 我多多少少知道怎么洗衣服。

sentences.en: But as I mentioned, those life skills, I think when you become a mum in your 20s or 30s, you've already potentially developed some of those life skills.
sentences.zh: 但正如我所提到的，那些生活技能，我觉得当你在20多岁或30多岁时成为妈妈，你可能已经培养了其中一些生活技能。

sentences.en: You might be living on your own, know a little bit more about money and so on.
sentences.zh: 你可能已经独自生活，对金钱等方面了解得更多。

sentences.en: And whereas when you are 14, 15, 16 and you still maybe not quite learn how to cook or how to navigate particular things around the house,
sentences.zh: 然而当你14、15、16岁时，你可能还没有完全学会如何做饭，或者如何处理家里的各种事情，

sentences.en: that's where that practical support is so beneficial.
sentences.zh: 这就是这种实际支持大显身手的时候。

sentences.en: So, yeah, let's bring those in, bring more of that.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，把这些带进来，带来更多这样的支持。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So let's talk briefly about your kind of your dedication and your striving to become a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 那么我们简短地聊聊你对成为一名心理学家的热爱和奋斗历程。

sentences.en: I know from before we hit record that your passion for that was ignited with some psychologist work that you'd received in Spain.
sentences.zh: 在录音之前我就知道，你对这行的热情是被你在西班牙接受过的一些心理学辅导点燃的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: So I had a bit of involvement from a school psychologist in Spain.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在西班牙接触过学校心理学家。

sentences.en: So they're psychologists that are based within school settings and support children for a variety of reasons.
sentences.zh: 所以她们是驻扎在学校环境中的心理学家，出于各种原因支持儿童。

sentences.en: And the reasons that I had involvement were due to some difficult experiences that I had whilst I was living in Spain.
sentences.zh: 我接触她们的原因是我在西班牙居住期间经历了一些困难。

sentences.en: And one day as I was leaving the last session that I was having with her, she kind of shouted over to me, Hayley, one day you'd make an exceptional psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 有一天，当我离开与她的最后一次咨询时，她冲我喊道：海莉，总有一天你会成为一名优秀的心理学家。

sentences.en: And at the time I kind of brushed it off and thought, yes, whatever, I don't really care about this,
sentences.zh: 当时我只是耸耸肩，心想，好吧，随便吧，我根本不在乎这个，

sentences.en: because I was really adamant I wanted to be a writer and I had lots of other passions.
sentences.zh: 因为我当时铁了心想成为一名作家，而且我还有很多其他的热情。

sentences.en: However, that really stuck with me.
sentences.zh: 然而，这句话真的深深印在了我脑海里。

sentences.en: And I'd always been very passionate about supporting children, young people.
sentences.zh: 而且我一直对支持儿童和年轻人充满热情。

sentences.en: And I was known within my community for standing up to the bullies.
sentences.zh: 我在社区里以敢于站出来对抗霸凌而闻名。

sentences.en: I was a bit of a fighter at school, but not I wouldn't initiate the fights.
sentences.zh: 我在学校里有点像个斗士，但不是我会主动挑起争端的那种。

sentences.en: People would come to me because they knew that I would stand up for them and be an advocate for them.
sentences.zh: 人们会来找我，因为他们知道我会为他们挺身而出，为他们仗义执言。

sentences.en: So I think as I was going through my really challenging times, I started to reflect on how I didn't want any other young people to experience the things that I'd experienced.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，当我经历那些极具挑战的时期时，我开始反思，我不希望任何其他年轻人经历我所经历过的事情。

sentences.en: So that's where I discovered this passion for becoming a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是我发现自己对成为一名心理学家充满热情的起点。

sentences.en: I wasn't entirely sure what type.
sentences.zh: 我当时并不十分确定是什么具体方向。

sentences.en: I didn't really understand that there were lots of different areas to go into when it comes to psychology.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道心理学其实有很多不同的细分领域。

sentences.en: And it's then when I came back to England when I was 17 years old, I started really looking into it.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，当我17岁回到英国后，我开始真正深入了解它。

sentences.en: But people didn't believe that I was going to be capable of becoming a psychologist because it is quite hard.
sentences.zh: 但人们不相信我有能力成为一名心理学家，因为这相当困难。

sentences.en: It does take time.
sentences.zh: 这确实需要时间。

sentences.en: You do have to go to university.
sentences.zh: 你必须去上大学。

sentences.en: And when you've been a young parent and when you've left school at the age of 14 and you have no qualifications, no job experience, then everything is much more difficult.
sentences.zh: 当你曾是个年轻父母，当你14岁就辍学且没有任何文凭、工作经验时，一切都会变得困难得多。

sentences.en: And I do remember going into a careers advice centre when I first came back to the UK when I was 17 and saying,
sentences.zh: 我确实记得当我17岁刚回到英国时，我去了一家职业咨询中心，然后说，

sentences.en: I'd quite like to be a psychologist without really knowing much more than that at that point.
sentences.zh: 我想当一名心理学家，当时除了这个之外我真的知之甚少。

sentences.en: And she tried to encourage me to become a hairdresser instead because hairdressing is much easier to get into.
sentences.zh: 她试图鼓励我去当个美发师，因为美发更容易入行。

sentences.en: You didn't need qualifications for it.
sentences.zh: 不需要什么学历。

sentences.en: I could do an apprenticeship or whatever.
sentences.zh: 我可以去做学徒或者别的什么。

sentences.en: And she told me that it would take a very long time and it's very competitive, very academic.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我这需要很长时间，而且竞争非常激烈，学术性很强。

sentences.en: Essentially, she was saying that she didn't believe that I would be capable because I was a young parent.
sentences.zh: 本质上，她是在说她不相信我有这个能力，因为我是一个年轻的父母。

sentences.en: I was a single mum by that point and obviously had no qualifications.
sentences.zh: 那时我是一个单亲妈妈，而且显然没有任何学历。

sentences.en: So my dreams at that moment were completely destroyed.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个瞬间，我的梦想彻底破灭了。

sentences.en: And I did go and try hairdressing.
sentences.zh: 我确实去尝试了美发。

sentences.en: Hairdressing was not for me.
sentences.zh: 美发不适合我。

sentences.en: I love hairdressers.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢美发师。

sentences.en: I have a lot of respect for them.
sentences.zh: 我对他们非常尊重。

sentences.en: It was not the right job for me.
sentences.zh: 但这不是适合我的工作。

sentences.en: I simply could not get on with it.
sentences.zh: 我实在无法适应它。

sentences.en: So I spent a few years feeling quite disheartened, not really knowing where to go, what to do with my life because people had shut me down.
sentences.zh: 所以我度过了好几年感到相当灰心丧气的日子，由于梦想遭到打压，我真的不知道该去哪里，不知道该拿自己的人生怎么办。

sentences.en: But I did have this internal dream to be a psychologist of some type and help people.
sentences.zh: 但我内心深处一直有个梦想，就是成为某种心理学家去帮助别人。

sentences.en: And it was then several years later that I, by that point, met my now husband.
sentences.zh: 直到几年后，那时我已经遇到了现在的丈夫。

sentences.en: And he was the person that really strongly advocated that I study psychology.
sentences.zh: 他是那个极力主张我去学习心理学的人。

sentences.en: He felt that it would fulfill me and that my life would completely change rather than feeling so stuck.
sentences.zh: 他觉得这会让我感到充实，并且我的生活会彻底改变，而不是总觉得困顿不前。

sentences.en: And that's when I really felt that, yes, actually, I could look at doing this.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我真正觉得，是的，其实我可以考虑这样做。

sentences.en: I can look at studying online, which I did my degree with the Open University.
sentences.zh: 我可以考虑在线学习，我的学位就是通过开放大学完成的。

sentences.en: And I also felt that it would be really inspiring and powerful for my little boy to see.
sentences.zh: 而且我也觉得，让我的小男孩看到这一切会非常有启发性和力量感。

sentences.en: So that by the time he became 18, he'd be able to say, actually, my mum had worked really hard to give me a better life and to better herself.
sentences.zh: 这样等他长到18岁时，他会说：其实，我的妈妈曾非常努力地工作，为了给我更好的生活，也为了提升她自己。

sentences.en: So that's the snapshot story of, yeah, my dreams to become a psychologist and the hard work that needed to go into it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的梦想——成为一名心理学家的心路历程剪影，以及为之付出的艰辛努力。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: But what if that first careers advisor had had given you the support and encouragement that your now husband did, you know,
sentences.zh: 但如果当初那个职业顾问能像你现在的丈夫那样给予你支持和鼓励，你知道的，

sentences.en: because that actually would have really sped up the journey for you and would have validated that rather than dismissing and disparaging your dreams and shooting you down?
sentences.zh: 因为那样其实真的会加速你的征程，会去肯定你的梦想，而不是贬低、轻视并打消你的积极性？

sentences.en: Like, yeah.
sentences.zh: 就像是，真的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that things could have been very, very different.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得事情可能会完全、完全不一样。

sentences.en: I think that I could have had a couple of years where I wasn't as lost and didn't feel so terrible, terrible about myself because I was essentially believing what she'd said,
sentences.zh: 我觉得我可以少走好几年的弯路，不会那么迷茫，也不会觉得自己那么一无是处、糟糕透顶，因为我当时基本上全盘接受了她的话，

sentences.en: that I wasn't capable, that I wasn't good enough, I wasn't clever enough, all of those not very nice things that she shared.
sentences.zh: 认为自己没有能力，不够优秀，不够聪明，所有她说过那些不太好听的话。

sentences.en: So life would have been very different in that sense.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，人生会完全不同。

sentences.en: But also, if she would have supported me to find the way, then I think I would have had perhaps a more normal, not normal, but maybe more typical study experience.
sentences.zh: 但同时，如果她当时能支持我找到方法，那么我觉得我的求学经历可能会更正常一些，也不是说正常，但也许会更典型一些。

sentences.en: So, for example, I could have gone to college, I would have obtained my GCSEs, perhaps then I would have gone to college and done A-levels.
sentences.zh: 例如，我可以去上预科学校，拿到我的中学毕业证书，也许然后我会去上大学读高级水平课程。

sentences.en: And then perhaps I could have gone to a university in person to complete my degree.
sentences.zh: 接着或许我可以去实体大学完成我的学位。

sentences.en: Whereas instead, I found myself not doing A-levels at all, jumping straight to an open university degree.
sentences.zh: 然而相反，我发现自己根本没有读高级水平课程，而是直接跨越到了开放大学的学位。

sentences.en: And as much as I'm extremely thankful for the open university and I owe them, you know, an awful, an awful lot,
sentences.zh: 尽管我极其感激开放大学，我对他们亏欠了，你知道的，非常、非常多，

sentences.en: I definitely missed out on having the experience of going to university.
sentences.zh: 但我确实错过了去大学校园体验生活的经历。

sentences.en: You know, I always struggled to make friends because being a young mum and making friends can be extremely challenging.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我总是很难交到朋友，因为作为一个年轻妈妈去交朋友极具挑战性。

sentences.en: And I always felt very isolated and different from other people my age.
sentences.zh: 我总是感到非常孤立，和同龄人格格不入。

sentences.en: And that wasn't helped by the fact that I was then doing everything remotely.
sentences.zh: 而我当时所有事情都在远程完成，这让情况雪上加霜。

sentences.en: Whilst also working, I had to have a full-time job to pay the bills, whilst also trying to be a mum.
sentences.zh: 在努力当妈妈的同时还得工作，我必须拥有一份全职工作来付账单。

sentences.en: And then obviously a student at night.
sentences.zh: 然后显然晚上还要当学生。

sentences.en: You know, I spent every single evening, as soon as my little boy went to bed with my laptop, studying.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，每天晚上只要我的小男孩一上床睡觉，我就抱着笔记本电脑开始学习。

sentences.en: So it was absolutely exhausting.
sentences.zh: 所以这绝对是精疲力竭的。

sentences.en: And I do believe that it didn't need to be that difficult.
sentences.zh: 而且我坚信，这本不需要那么艰难。

sentences.en: That if that person would have been kinder and would have supported me, then I feel that I could have, one, got to becoming a qualified psychologist sooner,
sentences.zh: 如果那个人能更善良一些，能支持我，那么我觉得我可以：第一，更快地成为一名合格的心理学家，

sentences.en: but also enjoyed the journey a lot more.
sentences.zh: 而且还能更享受这段旅程。

sentences.en: Whereas for me, the journey was not enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 然而对我而言，这段旅程一点也不享受。

sentences.en: I've only just started enjoying life the last three, four years since I've qualified.
sentences.zh: 我直到最近三四年取得资格认证后，才开始真正享受生活。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I think if people are watching or listening to this episode and they're like, right, OK, now what next?
sentences.zh: 我想如果人们正在观看或收听这一集，他们会想，好吧，那接下来该怎么办？

sentences.en: I think I'm right in saying that it's kind of dependent on where people live.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我说得没错，这很大程度上取决于人们居住在哪里。

sentences.en: So there might be local charities that are supporting teenage mothers and their families and their children.
sentences.zh: 所以可能会有当地的慈善机构在支持年轻母亲及其家庭和孩子。

sentences.en: But actually, there's a provision in local councils called Early Help, which is not the same as kind of children in need and having to be involved.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，地方议会里有一项名为“早期帮助”的福利服务，这与那种需要介入的“需要帮助的儿童”并不一样。

sentences.en: And probably like any areas, some of the early help departments are better than others, but they might well be able to signpost you to other relevant agencies.
sentences.zh: 而且可能就像任何领域一样，一些早期帮助部门比其他部门更好，但他们很可能会指引你找到其他相关的机构。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: Please have a look what's in your local area.
sentences.zh: 请看一看你当地有哪些资源。

sentences.en: And it's also worth looking out, see if there are any children's centres in your area.
sentences.zh: 同时也值得留意一下，看看你所在的地区是否有任何儿童中心。

sentences.en: There are still some short start centres around.
sentences.zh: 现在周围仍然有一些“Sure Start”儿童中心。

sentences.en: Again, it is very much dependent on where you live in the country, but there is support out there.
sentences.zh: 同样，这很大程度上取决于你住在国家的哪个地方，但外面确实有支持。

sentences.en: You just have to sometimes dig a little bit to find it.
sentences.zh: 你有时只需要稍微挖掘一下就能找到它。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Where can people learn more about you and your work, Dr Hayley?
sentences.zh: 海莉博士，人们可以在哪里了解更多关于你和你的工作？

sentences.en: So I have a website that people can access, which is lugaseelearningsolutions.co.uk.
sentences.zh: 我有一个人们可以访问的网站，网址是lugaseelearningsolutions.co.uk。

sentences.en: So that's where they can find out a bit more about the work that I do as an educational psychologist,
sentences.zh: 这就是他们可以更多地了解我作为教育心理学家所做的工作的地方，

sentences.en: as well as the public speaking and training support that you offer to schools and organisations.
sentences.zh: 还有你为学校和组织提供的公开演讲和培训支持。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: If anyone's listening to this and wondering how we spell Lagasse, it is L-U-G-A-S-S-Y.
sentences.zh: 如果有人在听这个并想知道Lagasse是怎么拼写的，它是L-U-G-A-S-S-Y。

sentences.en: But all of the details will be in the show notes and in the description.
sentences.zh: 但所有的详细信息都会写在节目笔记和简介里。

sentences.en: Hayley, thank you so much for the work that you do.
sentences.zh: 海莉，非常感谢你所做的工作。

sentences.en: I'm so pleased that ultimately it's had a lovely outcome for you and your family.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴它最终为你和你的家人带来了美好的结果。

sentences.en: And well done on the incredible work you do as a qualified educational psychologist too.
sentences.zh: 而且你在担任合格教育心理学家期间所做的不凡工作也同样做得很好。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I love my chat with Dr Hayley and I hope you did too.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢与海莉博士的交谈，希望你也是。

sentences.en: If you did, please do let us know in the comments, either on YouTube or on Spotify, what you thought to the episode.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢，请在 YouTube 或 Spotify 的评论区告诉我们你对这期节目的看法。

sentences.en: You can also reach out to me wherever you are on social media, where I'm Dr Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 你也可以在各大社交媒体上找到我，我是玛丽安·特恩特博士。

sentences.en: I would love it if you would start sharing your favourite episodes to your social media stories
sentences.zh: 如果你能将你最喜欢的节目分享到你的社交媒体快拍

sentences.en: and accounts and tag me, Dr Marianne Trent, and I would love to get to know you there.
sentences.zh: 和账号中，并@我——玛丽安·特恩特博士，我会非常高兴能在那里认识你。

sentences.en: Has Dr Hayley's story inspired you?
sentences.zh: 海莉博士的故事启发了你吗？

sentences.en: I do hope so.
sentences.zh: 我真心希望如此。

sentences.en: I hope that we're beginning to shape and change the narrative and I would love to know your opinion.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们正在开始塑造和改变这种叙事，我很想知道你的看法。

sentences.en: If you are an aspiring psychologist and you're looking to get your foot in the door
sentences.zh: 如果你是一位有志成为心理学家的人，并且正在寻找入门的机会

sentences.en: to be able to think about all things psychology and the types of conversations psychologists have, please do consider joining the Aspiring Psychologist membership,
sentences.zh: 以便思考所有与心理学相关的事情以及心理学家们进行的各种对话，请考虑加入“有志心理学家”会员计划，

sentences.en: which you can do from just £30 a month with no minimum term.
sentences.zh: 每月只需 30 英镑起，且无最低合约期限。

sentences.en: Head to www.aspiring-psychologiSt.co.uk.
sentences.zh: Head to www.aspiring-psychologiSt.co.uk.

sentences.en: If you're a really big fan of the show and of me as a creator, you can also join my paid podcast membership community,
sentences.zh: 如果你是本节目以及我作为创作者的超级粉丝，你也可以加入我的付费播客会员社区，

sentences.en: which you can do on YouTube, you can do on Apple Podcasts and directly through Captivate.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过 YouTube、Apple Podcasts 以及直接通过 Captivate 加入。

sentences.en: You can get exclusive subscriber-only content and early access to the podcast too.
sentences.zh: 你还可以获得专属的订阅者专享内容以及播客的提前收听权限。

sentences.en: Check out all the details in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 请在节目简介中查看所有详细信息。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being here.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的收听。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚取超越“出售时间换取金钱”模式的收入呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特恩特博士，我自 2019 年以来一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 索菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员计划和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我本人于 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也一直陪伴并支持两届心理学家度过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的推广链接加入，你将获得索菲的额外福利以及我自己的专属支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组大师班、大师课程、个性化指导、一份福南梅森礼品以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时在线。
